meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan 👍 ₹700 ke andar acne-prone skin ke liye **salicylic acid** serum sabse practical choice rahega—especially agar pimples, blackheads ya clogged pores hain.

### Meri top picks

### [Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹224*

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹515*

### [The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹237*

### [Deconstruct Anti-Acne Clearing Serum]()
*₹524*

**🥇 Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid** — meri first choice. Current listings mein ~₹500–550 ke aas-paas hai, aur 2% salicylic acid acne/blackheads/oil control ke liye targeted hai. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** — agar acne ke saath **acne marks + oily skin** bhi hai, ye interesting option hai: **2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide**, around ₹527 on Tira. [www.tirabeauty.com](https://www.tirabeauty.com/collection/serum-for-oily-skin?super-ingredients=Niacinamide&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥉 Deconstruct Anti-Acne Clearing Serum** — agar skin thodi sensitive hai aur aap relatively gentler acne-focused option dekh rahe ho, consider kar sakte ho.

### Kaise use karna hai
- Raat mein **2–3 drops**, initially **week mein 2–3 baar**.
- Uske baad moisturizer.
- Din mein **SPF 30+ sunscreen**.
- Ek hi routine mein salicylic acid ke saath retinol/AHA-BHA peel jaise strong actives mat milao.
- Irritation, burning ya excessive dryness ho to stop/reduce frequency.

**Agar tum mujhe bata do ki tumhari skin oily, dry ya combination hai aur acne kis type ka hai (chhote pimples / pus wale / blackheads / acne marks), toh main ₹700 ke andar ekdum exact serum choose karke bata dunga.**
